title: You Are My Refuge

questions.question: With my voice I cry out to the Lord; with my voice I plead for mercy to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:1 (ESV): "with my voice I plead for mercy to the Lord."

questions.question: I pour out my complaint before him; I tell my trouble before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:2 (ESV): "I tell my trouble before him."

questions.question: When my spirit faints within me, you know my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:3 (ESV): "When my spirit faints within me, you know my way!"

questions.question: In the path where I walk they have hidden a what for me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:3 (ESV): "In the path where I walk they have hidden a trap for me."

questions.question: Look to the right and see: there is none who takes notice of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:4 (ESV): "there is none who takes notice of me;"

questions.question: No refuge remains to me; no one cares for my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:4 (ESV): "no one cares for my soul."

questions.question: I cry to you, O Lord; I say, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:5 (ESV): "my portion in the land of the living."

questions.question: Attend to my cry, for I am brought very what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:6 (ESV): "Attend to my cry, for I am brought very low!"

questions.question: Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:6 (ESV): "for they are too strong for me!"

questions.question: Bring me out of prison, that I may give thanks to your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:7 (ESV): "Bring me out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name!"

questions.question: Where was David when he wrote this Psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142 Title: "A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer."

questions.question: The righteous will surround me, for you will deal bountifully with whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:7 (ESV): "for you will deal bountifully with me."

questions.question: What is a "Maskil"?
questions.explanation: Hebrew title term implying instruction or contemplation.

questions.question: Which cave is it likely referring to?
questions.explanation: Places where David hid from Saul.

questions.question: What does David say about his refuge in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalm 142:4 (ESV): "No refuge remains to me;" (referring to human help).

key_verse_text: I cry to you, O Lord; I say, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."
